attribute_definition: Context concerns the physical functional and visual setting of an urban area including heritage setting surrounding development spatial relationships landmarks character areas and relationship between places.

Topography concerns landform elevation slope terrain relief aspect openness ruggedness drainage and the relationship between ground conditions urban form visibility routes enclosure and townscape setting.

Grain concerns the pattern size density rhythm and arrangement of plots blocks streets building footprints parcels urban fabric historic patterns fine grain coarse grain permeability and morphological texture.
Form concerns building scale height massing frontage materials architectural form façade composition roofscape skyline enclosure density building type and three dimensional urban morphology.

Land-use concerns the distribution mixture intensity and spatial organisation of residential commercial institutional industrial recreational and mixed uses including activity patterns and functional zoning.

Water concerns rivers canals lakes ponds watercourses drainage reservoirs waterfronts hydrological features blue infrastructure floodplain relationships and the contribution of water bodies to townscape character.
Vegetation concerns trees green space planting canopy cover green view index parks gardens urban forest landscape ecology vegetation structure and green infrastructure.

Public realm concerns streets squares open spaces pedestrian spaces visual quality environmental perception comfort safety urban vitality social activity street furniture and experiential quality of shared urban space.
Connectivity concerns street networks movement accessibility walkability permeability pedestrian routes intersections centrality betweenness closeness transport access paths nodes and links.
